description: Azure DevOps hooks: a SessionStart configuration/profile health check (context only, silent when healthy), process-aware validation of five work-item/PR write tools, a permissionDecision 'ask' gate on every other Azure DevOps MCP write tool (list: rules/write-gate.md), and a Bash 'ask' gate on Azure DevOps CLI write verbs (az devops|boards|repos|pipelines|artifacts) and on git push to an Azure DevOps remote. Matchers also accept the un-namespaced tool names of a globally configured azure-devops server.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start_check.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
